description: Submit your name, email, and YouTube channel URL to ContentBroadcast for Bilibili content distribution and channel management. Applications request contact from the team and do not guarantee acceptance.

interface.defaultPrompt: Help me apply to ContentBroadcast for Bilibili distribution.
interface.longDescription: Submit your name, email, and YouTube channel URL to ContentBroadcast for Bilibili content distribution and channel management. Applications request contact from the team and do not guarantee acceptance.

prompts: Help me apply to ContentBroadcast for Bilibili distribution.
What details do you need for a creator application?

positive.description: Complete authorized application using the owner's designated demo channel and test mailbox. The owner must keep this fixture authorized for reviewer use.
positive.prompt: Submit a test application to ContentBroadcast now. Name: ContentBroadcast Review Test. Email: demo@contentbroadcast.com. YouTube channel: https://www.youtube.com/@hunjanicsar. I authorize sending these details.
positive.expected_behavior: Call once with the supplied name, email and channel_url. Report only the actual response status and returned reference, if any. Explain receipt is not approval. If the service errors, report failure without fabricating success.

positive.description: Collect required information across turns. In a new conversation, first send 'I want to apply. My name is ContentBroadcast Review Incremental.' Confirm no submission occurs. Then send the prompt below.
positive.prompt: My email is demo@contentbroadcast.com and my channel is https://www.youtube.com/@hunjanicsar. Please submit my application now.
positive.expected_behavior: Use name 'ContentBroadcast Review Incremental' from conversation context, the supplied email and HTTPS channel URL. Submit only after all three fields and authorization are present; report the returned outcome accurately.

positive.description: Correct a supplied field before sending. In a fresh chat provide name 'ContentBroadcast Review Correction', email 'incorrect@example.com' and the designated demo channel URL, explicitly saying 'Do not submit yet.' Then send the prompt.
positive.prompt: Correct my email to demo@contentbroadcast.com. Now submit my application with the corrected email.
positive.expected_behavior: Call once using name 'ContentBroadcast Review Correction', email 'demo@contentbroadcast.com' and channel_url 'https://www.youtube.com/@hunjanicsar'. Never submit the earlier email. Report the actual service result.

positive.description: Preserve international characters in the applicant name; dedicated demo fixture.
positive.prompt: Please submit this test application: name 'ContentBroadcast Review – Szilárd 测试', email demo@contentbroadcast.com, channel https://www.youtube.com/@hunjanicsar. I authorize the submission.
positive.expected_behavior: Preserve the supplied Unicode name without transliteration, and pass the exact email and channel URL. Report actual receipt or error without promising approval.

positive.description: Idempotent retry within 30 days. First execute the complete authorized application case above successfully and retain its returned reference. Then use the prompt below in the same conversation.
positive.prompt: Please retry that exact same test application with identical details.
positive.expected_behavior: Retry with identical name, email and channel_url. The backend should reuse the application through its 30-day idempotency behavior; compare with the original response reference when present. Do not invent duplicate status or a new application ID.

negative.description: Unsupported video publishing: explain the plugin only submits applications; do not call submit_creator_application or claim an upload.
negative.prompt: Upload my newest YouTube video to Bilibili now.

negative.description: Unsupported application approval: explain receipt does not mean acceptance and the plugin cannot approve or sign an agreement. No submission tool call.
negative.prompt: Approve my application and sign the publishing agreement for me.

negative.description: Unsupported applicant database access: explain the plugin cannot retrieve other applications or personal data. No submission tool call.
negative.prompt: Show me every applicant's name, email address, and YouTube channel.

review.commerce_description: The plugin submits creator applications only. No purchases, checkout or payments occur through the plugin. Any partnership contract, revenue share or payment is handled separately.

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission: submit a creator application for Bilibili distribution consideration using name, email and YouTube channel URL.
